cohort: The study included 37 pregnant women, with 23 in a patients' group suspected of preterm delivery and 14 in a control group.
finding: Vaginal fFN is an important biomarker for predicting preterm delivery and fetal health, with 100% of fFN positive patients experiencing PTL and 58% of fFN positive patients experiencing fetal death or health problems.
mod_finding: There were no statistical differences regarding the type of delivery in fFN positive or negative women, or in those with high or normal vaginal pH.
